newsitem.title: USA: Dubilier & Co to buy CPC melba toast unit.
newsitem.headline: Dubilier & Co to buy CPC melba toast unit.

text.p: Dubilier & Co said on Wednesday it has reached an agreement to purchase CPC International's melba toast business, including its Bronx facility, through an affiliated company.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
The business includes: Old London and Devonsheer melba toast, rounds, and bread crumbs; Old London and Toastettes croutons; and JJ Flats flatbreads, Dubilier said.
The production facility currently employs approximately 200 people, Dubilier said. The sale is expected to be completed within two months, the company said.
